look_here_first: CAROLINA CANARYGRASS: small cool-season annual with tightly contracted bright green, often egglike/oblong pointed flowering panicle. Examine the laterally flattened spikelet: two relatively broad similar boatlike keeled glumes enclosing a fertile floret and reduced basal sterile structures. Compare to the introduced Phalaris minor; a compact tufted seedhead alone isn't enough.

crew_field_check: Polypogon monspeliensis has a much softer fluffy bristly/awned cylindrical bottlebrush, whereas Phalaris has a firm compact head with broad keeled glumes around individual spikelets. Phalaris minor similar and generally introduced; dissect glumes plus sterile lemmas with macro.
